name: All of History, All at Once
oracle_text:
Time travel. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)
Storm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn.)
blocked_sentences: Time travel. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)

needs.what: an op that, for each suspended card the controller owns (exile, suspended_by == controller, time counters > 0) and each permanent they control with a time counter, lets them choose to add one time counter, remove one, or do nothing; removing the last time counter from a suspended card must cast it for free as suspend does (702.62), and the removal goes through the same COUNTER_REMOVED / TIME_COUNTER_REMOVED funnel
needs.why_existing_wont_do: for_each + choose_mode over add_counters/remove_counters is the near miss, but no selector key reads 'suspended' (has_counters on exile also matches non-suspended exiled cards with time counters), and the free cast on the last counter lives only in suspend.tick at upkeep, so an effect removing the last counter would strand the card in exile with zero counters. Storm itself is expressible (Brain Freeze's copy_spell with spells_cast_this_turn minus 1).
